name: Demon Busters ~Ecchi na Ecchi na Demon Taiji~
original_name: デーモンバスターズ ～えっちなえっちなデーモン退治～
source:
Kou is a member of the public morals committee at Moriyaji Gakuen, along with his osananajimi Ai and kouhai Karen. One day while he was making the rounds after school, he was attacked by a weird being. He was frozen in fear and could not evade its attack, but he was saved by two girls, Konoka and Lizera. They were ‘daemon busters’ who fight against daemons borne from the lust and cravings of humans. They told him that he was a kyuumashi who could absorb the desires that create daemons, and they asked for his help since his special ability makes their battles much easier. When he uses his ability, it causes him to be able to see girls naked and also makes them horny. If the daemons aren’t defeated, then their lust will cause the whole school to become an orgy. As part of the public morals committee, he can’t let that happen!

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/10/14/october-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
Kou与他的osananajimi Ai和kouhai Karen一起是守矢路学园公共道德委员会的成员。有一天，当他放学后闲逛时，他遭到了一种奇怪生物的袭击。他被吓得僵住了，无法躲避它的攻击，但被Konoka和Lizera这两个女孩救了。他们是“恶魔克星”，与人类的欲望和渴望所产生的恶魔作斗争。他们告诉他，他是一个九魔师，可以吸收创造恶魔的欲望，并且他们请求他的帮助，因为他的特殊能力使他们的战斗变得更加容易。当他使用他的能力时，他可以看到女孩的裸体，也让她们变得饥渴。如果恶魔没有被击败，那么它们的欲望将会导致整个学校陷入狂欢。作为公共道德委员会的一员，他不能让这样的事情发生！

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/10/14/october-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
